text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I love running!
It's thrilling and so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And you know, I think it'd be even more fun
if I could come in 1st! So I'm gonna
get 1st place in the race! I'll do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
